crag.name: Arkelstorp
crag.access_info:
❗️IMPORTANT INFO❗️

🚫 For "Bleaustenen", make sure to stay on the small trail up to the bloc – avoid making new paths!
⛔️ For the blocs by "Big G", be very conservative about brushing off moss!
🤫 The parking for "Värestorp" lies close to some houses – keep a low profile here!
🤫 The approach to "Ehmanns vägg" goes just past a house – keep a low profile here!
🗑 Remove all of your trash!
🧹 Brush off tickmarks and excessive chalk!
🚜 Park so that large vehicles can pass by!

PARKING
• See Parkings on the map. OBS: "Bleaustenen" and "Ballerina" have quite tight parking spots with max 1 car.

APPROACH
• See the GPS trails on the map.
• If the gate into Hallaboda/Bleaustenen is locked (sometimes it's closed without being locked), park by the gate and walk 500m-1km extra.
